field_text_formatted.value: Each app that reads your API is a consumer, and each gets its own preview targets, so a Next site and an Astro build can preview the same draft. Anything that reads JSON:API can be on the other end, and Druxt Node Preview 0.1.0 is the Nuxt one, already running druxtjs.org's previews.
